product_launches.description: Think launched Think Grid, a managed dedicated AI compute service providing cloud-like access to Think Fabric infrastructure through a monthly subscription. The service initially operates in Saudi Arabia and is being rolled out globally.

overview_description.description:
Think is an AI infrastructure company built around a single obsession: efficiency. Idle silicon is the AI industry's single most expensive invisible cost, and it appears on no budget. Most AI infrastructure splits into silos, one environment for inference, another for training, each waiting on the other while utilization drops and OpEx climbs. The problem is not the hardware. It is everything that fails to orchestrate it.

Think solves this at the root. Liquid-cooled, multi-GPU compute nodes engineered in symbiosis with ILM, a purpose-built hardware-aware orchestration platform that knows what every GPU, every thermal envelope, and every watt can deliver. ILM runs pre-training, fine-tuning, and inference on the same nodes, scheduled dynamically, so silicon never sits idle and teams never juggle fragmented tools. Scaling is just as simple: one orchestration layer from a single desk-side node to entire rack-scale fleet deployments, same orchestration throughout, no re-architecture, no added complexity.

The result: maximum utilization, radically lower energy use and TCO, and the entire AI workflow made simpler and more efficient. Every GPU runs cooler, lasts longer, and earns its depreciation instead of sitting idle. Fully sovereign infrastructure. Every model, every watt, every dollar under your control: compute you own as an asset, not a cost that compounds.

AI infrastructure that thinks.
